name: Sounds of Talent: Kpop Adventure
source:
Become a famous K-pop idol, and discover the exciting Korean music scene in this interactive story.

You just moved to Seoul and started your studies in the exclusive Gangnam Art School, where more than one surprise is waiting for you.

Will you take the opportunities that appear in the way?
Are you ready to become the next pop sensation? 

[From [url=https://soundsoftalent.com/]official website[/url]]
translation:
成为著名K-pop偶像，探索令人兴奋的韩国音乐圈。

你刚搬到首尔，开始在精英学校江南艺术学校学习，那里有更多惊喜等待着你。

你会抓住出现的机会吗？
准备成为下一个流行巨星了吗？
